text:
rachel_revops: Heads up - Diego has a mid-market POC with NimbusWare. They're asking for a 6-week pilot with a $75k reserved commit and a one-time 35% onboarding discount. Can we follow the new expedited flow? @meera_dealdesk
diego_sales: Quote Q-987-NIMBUS. I set `discount_pct__c=35` and `commit_level__c=reserved_75k`. Marked `priority__c=expedite`. Need the route and estimated SLA.
meera_dealdesk: 35% sits at the edge of auto-approval. Our system auto-escalates anything >=30. For this flow we'll need Deal Desk + RevOps approval; Legal only if there are special terms. Please set `approval_path__c=dealdesk+revops`. Also attach the technical runbook and the POC acceptance criteria docs.
rachel_revops: Noted. Diego - please add `billing_floor__c=$45,000` and `trial_period_days__c=42` so finance has a minimum. Also add `discount_reason__c="one-time onboarding offer"`.
nate_se: Quick note about infra: NimbusWare expects cross-account VPC peering and wants logs forwarded. Add `security_review=true` and I'll tag eng-sre for the details.
pricing-bot: Pricing check complete for Q-987-NIMBUS: suggested alternative - 25% + $10K onboarding credit if you want faster auto-approval.
meera_dealdesk: If you accept the hybrid (25% + $10k credit) the routing will be auto-approved by Deal Desk. Diego - Do you want me to propose that to customer?
diego_sales: I'll try the customer for the hybrid, but hold the 35% route as fallback. Can you open DD ticket?
meera_dealdesk: Opened DD-4754. Routing set to dealdesk+revops. Triage ETA 3 hours, routing to approvers within 1 business day. Please ensure all CPQ fields are filled: `quote_folder__c=escalations/poc`, `template__c=POC-Standard`, `escalation_reason__c="mid-market pilot - onboarding incentive"`.
tara_legal: If they request any data retention exceptions, Legal needs to review. Otherwise I can stand down.
rachel_revops: Thanks team. Diego - let us know if customer agrees to hybrid; that'll speed approval. :rocket:
